text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's a GⅠ race that decides the Mile King of the Classic Class.
We must make sure to collect proper data."

Before she set off muttering to herself like that,
there was something I wanted to ask her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I was just a little concerned.
Her running form... felt different from usual.
—In the end, the day arrived without me ever finding out the truth behind the 'way of running' that Manhattan Cafe had let slip.
choice_data_list: How has your running style changed?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief! That again?!
I thought I told you that Cafe simply misunderstood.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides... even if it's not a misunderstanding,
if I haven't spoken of it, it simply means
the time has not yet come.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The only thing you need concern yourself with is
how well I can run today—and that alone—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even if your attention is drawn to other things,
would there be any meaningful point in doing so?
Agnes Tachyon tilts her head with a quizzical "Hm?", leaving me at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If there's no point—no, even if there is,
we are not speaking of this for a while. Understand?
Saying that, she left the waiting room without any explanation after all.
